'''Sturdy leather leggings''' are the [[Sturdy leather armor|sturdy leather]] [[Armor#Leggings|leggings]], crafted from 7 [[sturdy leather]]. Sturdy leather armor is a light set built against arrows and falls.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}
The leggings found in [[village]] tannery chests are an older version of the item. In 1.12.2 they are invisible when worn: their equipment asset is <code>minecraft:sturdy_leather</code>, but the resource pack defines the texture as <code>matcha:sturdy_leather</code>. They also give 1 block of safe fall distance instead of 2, have one extra random enchantment, and are repaired with sturdy leather instead of tattered leather.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/equipment/sturdy_leather.json}}</ref> See [[Sturdy leather armor#Village tannery chests]].

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
They give 3 armor with 350 durability and 2 blocks of safe fall distance, twice what leather gives. Projectile Protection III comes on the item as an ordinary enchantment.

=== Repairing ===
They can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[tattered leather]]. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so they can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
